title: observability: token-level logging + enhanced metrics/tracing dashboards + alert tuning
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR implements token-level logging and enriches observability dashboards and alerting for token-level cost and latency breakdowns. Motivation: operators need finer-grained visibility into per-request token costs, KV cache hit/miss impacts, and latency distribution to diagnose regressions after model swaps or quantization changes. Scope: 1) add token-level counters and histograms to runtime request path (cost.tokens_total, latency.per_token_ms histogram, kv.cache_hits, kv.cache_misses) with labels: model, route, customer_tier, quantization_profile; 2) wire tracing spans to include tokenization/dencode/kv stages and propagate span IDs into existing request traces; 3) introduce a new Grafana dashboard JSON (observability/token-level-cost-latency.json) with panels for token cost breakdown, per-model latency percentiles, KV hit-rate heatmap, and top-k routes by cost; 4) add alert tuning changes: lower threshold for p99 latency anomalies when token rate > 10k/min, add composite alert for KV-miss spikes correlated with latency regressions; 5) add migration guide and example queries for the console and public docs. Checklist: - [x] Add metrics and tagging to runtime - [x] Add tracing spans and propagate context - [x] Add dashboard JSON and templates - [x] Add alert conditions and alert docs - [x] Unit/integration tests for metrics emission - [x] Update docs and changelog Notes: kept metric cardinality bounded by using a limited tag set and by hashing long route names into route_bucket label. See linked Linear ENG-3421 for operator requirements and SUP-8812 for customer report attached to incident. This description is intentionally compact and single-line for PR export consistency.
commits: Wire tracing spans for tokenization/kv stages (runtime/tracing/span.go)
Add Grafana dashboard and alert rules JSON, docs and migration guide
review_comments: Miguel Rivera: Please confirm cardinality guards for `route_bucket`  we should limit to top 1k routes and hash the rest. Author reply: addressed, added hashing + sampling and documented the limit in runtime/metrics/collector.go comments.

Samir Khan: The composite alert looks noisy in initial runs; can we require sustained window of 5m and correlate with KV miss rate > 3x baseline? Author reply: updated rules to require 5m sustained and added baseline calculation via moving average. Added e2e to validate behavior.
Lena Ortiz: Can you include an example Query for Console -> Cost Breakdown that operators can paste? Author reply: added examples in docs and Console template with prepopulated variables.
Miguel Rivera: Unit tests flaked on CI initially (metrics export race), please add retry/backoff where appropriate. Author reply: added a retry in tests and fixed a race in collector shutdown code.
Samir Khan: Approved after requested changes.
release_notes: Add token-level observability: new token-cost and per-token latency metrics, KV cache hit/miss metrics, new dashboard and tuned alerts. Operators should review migration guide to add route_bucket sampling to their configs. This change is backward compatible and requires no runtime migration steps.
